_comment: Tiny-VRAM ComfyUI API-format txt2img graph: no in-graph upscale. Renders a %latent_width%x%latent_height% latent (bounded by COMFYUI_LATENT_MAX_PIXELS) and saves it at that native size - it does not also decode into an upscale pass, which is what a 3GB-class card (the GPU Worker Render Capacity constraint) was observed to run out of VRAM on. scripts/generation.py selects this template automatically instead of comfyui_workflow_lowvram_upscale.json when the worker's own /system_stats reports total VRAM under COMFYUI_UPSCALE_MIN_VRAM_MB, unless COMFYUI_WORKFLOW pins a template explicitly. The requested %width%/%height% are not reached here; upscaling this asset to the pipeline's target size is deferred to a later step (ffmpeg at render time, or a higher-VRAM provider), never claimed as already done.
